applies_to: every future predictive execution, including any separately authorized T2 execution
persist_during_original_execution: fitted preprocessors, imputers, scalers and encoders
fitted TEXT vectorizers with vocabulary, IDF and feature order
OOF fold lineage and any required fitted fold states
model, serializer, runtime and platform metadata
row-level raw, fused, calibrated and final predictions as applicable
XAI compatibility metadata including supported output scales
timing: Persist and hash fitted state before held-out scoring whenever scientifically and operationally possible; seal it together with the execution evidence.
portability: Use family-native portable formats plus canonical semantic-state records; pickle alone is insufficient.
purpose: Prevent future post-hoc reconstruction from becoming a prerequisite for governed XAI.
